litematica.gui.label.schematic_manager.e:
Change the selected litematics' Preview in the Metadata
- Ctrl + click the other button to select a preview image.
§bClick this button to cycle this option
techutils.config.litematic.comment.rende:
Show 3D render of selected litematic in Load Schematics menu
(Works only for .litematic files)
techutils.config.litematic.comment.overr: Show 3D render even if litematic has its own preview
techutils.config.litematic.comment.mirro: Cycle through selected placement's mirroring options
techutils.config.litematic.comment.refre:
Refreshes active Litematica material list.
§7This can be used in combination with layered lists to update the HUD when changing the active layer.
techutils.config.litematic.comment.easyP:
Treat all blocks as full cubes when using Litematica's easy place feature.
§7Useful for placing blocks with small hitboxes like buttons, chains, fences, etc.
techutils.config.litematic.comment.verif:
Make the inventory verifier enforce exact item component matches.
§7Also adds the present components to the lore!
techutils.config.litematic.comment.repla: When loading a schematic, replaces each Item Predicate with its stored placeholder, if present.
techutils.config.litematic.comment.force: Overwrite each slot in the opened container to show the schematic item instead of the real one.
techutils.config.worldedit.comment.autoW: Synchronise WorldEdit region to active Litematica selection

Ticks to wait before synchronising WorldEdit selection.
(Increase in case of poor connection or if you get kicked because of spam)
Shows an actionbar message when WorldEdit region is syncronised
techutils.config.worldedit.comment.autoD:
Automatically disable WorldEdit neighbour updates on server join.
(Has the same effect as running //perf neighbors off)
techutils.config.misc.comment.compactSco:
Show scoreboard values in compact notation.
For example: 123456 -> 123.4K
techutils.config.misc.comment.giveFullIn:
Give full inventory of an item with following rules:
- Main hand: item; Off hand: none; Result: shulker box of item.
- Main hand: item; Off hand: container; Result: container of item.
- Main hand: item; Off hand: bundle; Result: bundle of item * config.
- Main hand: empty shulker box; Off hand: none: Result: chest of stacked boxes.
- Main hand: empty shulker box; Off hand: container; Result: container of stacked boxes.
- Main hand: shulker box; Off hand: none: Result: chest of full boxes.
- Main hand: shulker box; Off hand: container; Result: container of full boxes.
techutils.config.misc.comment.bundleFill: Amount of stacks to put in a bundle when using giveFullInv feature
techutils.config.misc.comment.fillSafety:
Restrict nested containers to prevent crashing yourself.
Here be cats and scratches!
techutils.config.misc.comment.fillCooldo: Cooldown in milliseconds between filling operations
techutils.config.misc.comment.requestTim: Time in game ticks before request is considered failed
